references.title: 基于LabVIEW的霍尔效应测量磁场仿真实验平台
locators: p.116 section 1.1 equations (1)–(3), Hall sensitivity and its units
p.116 section 1.2 equations (4)–(8), four polarities and same-parity residual
notes: All ten pages read; rendered pp.116–117 inspected.
Equation (6) switching label is printed +Is,+Im but its signs and section 3.1 imply -Is,-Im.
Equation (2) uses d after defining h; both mean Hall plate thickness.
The same-parity Ettingshausen voltage remains in equation (8); its magnitude is not established as zero.
The duplicated denominator term in equation (11) and off-axis formulas are not used by this project.
Printed equations (4)–(7) give UO, UN and UR the same current-odd sign pattern; project independent field-odd and common bases are abstract teaching perturbations, not identified material effects.
references.application: p.116式(1)–(3)支持线性霍尔关系$V_H=K_HIB$。$R_H$是材料霍尔系数，量纲$\mathrm{m^3/C}$；$K_H=R_H/h$是片厚相关灵敏度，量纲$\mathrm{V/(A\,T)}$。论文先以$h$定义厚度，式(2)换成$d$，这里统一视为同一片厚。论文以正的$e$书写电压大小，项目符号由换向顺序约定，不由这些幅值式反推载流子类型。
